Definition: to subside; by implication, to be overflowed, cease; causatively, to abate, subdue
BiblicalUsage: 1) to sink, sink down, subside; 1a) (Qal) to sink; 1b) (Niphal) to sink, collapse; 1c)(Hiphil) to sink down, cause to settle
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
